quote: Brain Bridge is so great to work with. They are knowledgeable and walk you through the process to make sure that solutions are well thought out.
Having an HR background was very useful for Josh to understand the problems we face and how an AI Teammate will help us

Today’s AI workshop was super fun and incredibly insightful! I discovered new tools, learned how to really engage with them, and picked up great tips for optimizing prompts. It was hands-on, engaging, and left me excited to put my new skills to work. I highly recommend this workshop to anyone curious about unlocking the power of AI!
Brain Bridge trained our AI Teammate to handle meeting summaries, and create hand off checklists. After that, everything just clicked. Super simple and immediately valuable!
We deployed our AI Teammate to manage follow-ups. The impact was instant. Less dropped balls, faster responses. The process was smooth because Brain Bridge built it with our team. Feels like magic!

I think the most valuable aspect of the AI Lab is the no-judgement landscape. Sharing friction that come from one department or another is a little hard sometimes. This created a safe space for all of us to share our friction points without having tension between co-workers.
I love the ability to help mold the personality of our new teammate!
